title: ClaView period-resolution augmentation set (2026-10-02)
description: Extends golden_set_v1.schema.json's case shape for cases added specifically to probe claview.stages.resolve_relative_period beyond the original 22 golden_set_v1 cases: adds the 'H'(반기) frequency, and a required 'policy_status' + 'period_candidates' pair per case so an ambiguous or currently-broken relative-period interpretation is tracked explicitly rather than asserted as a single silent truth. See README_기간증강.md for how to read this file.

as_of.description: The Config.as_of this case was authored and hand-derived against. All cases in this file use the same value as the shared pytest `config` fixture so they replay under the identical as_of -- recorded here so the value is never re-guessed.

policy_status.description: implemented: the expected period follows a rule the team has already agreed on and the current code reproduces it exactly. assumption_untested: current code resolves to *a* period without erroring, but which convention is correct is not yet settled (see period_candidates) -- current output is recorded as expected so a regression is caught, not because it is confirmed correct. open_bug: the expected period is the human-reasoned correct answer, but current code raises an error instead of returning it -- this case is expected to FAIL against current code until the team decides and fixes it, the same way CV-AB-12 did before the Q-specific rule.

period_candidates.description: Named competing interpretations considered for this query (e.g. 'sliding_window' vs 'calendar_anchor', or 'as_of_year_based' vs 'anchor_year_based'). Exactly one of these equals expected.B.selections[*].period for policy_status != open_bug; for open_bug it holds the human-reasoned fallback the code does not yet produce, labeled 'anchor_year_fallback' or similar.

kosis_verification.description: Filled in by running scripts/verify_periods_kosis.py against the real KOSIS API -- not yet run as of this file's creation, so every case starts as status=pending.
